# Test fixtures

Three document roots that kbview is pointed at, by the automated tests and by a
human clicking through the running app. Between them they cover every input
shape the app claims to handle.

```sh
cargo run -p kbview-server -- \
  --root ./test/fixtures/obsidian-vault \
  --root ./test/fixtures/plain-markdown \
  --root ./test/fixtures/mixed-media
```

`verify_fixtures.py` asserts that everything below is still true. Run it after
touching anything in this directory:

```sh
python3 test/fixtures/verify_fixtures.py   # 133 checks, exits non-zero on failure
```

Every binary here was generated byte by byte from the Python standard library —
no PNG/JPEG/PDF/DOCX library was involved, and nothing was copied in from an
unknown source. If you need to regenerate one, read the checks in
`verify_fixtures.py` first: they are the spec.

---

## `obsidian-vault/` — vault mode

Auto-detected as an Obsidian vault because it contains `.obsidian/`.

| Path | Why it exists |
| --- | --- |
| `.obsidian/appearance.json` | Presence of `.obsidian/` is what flips the app into vault mode. `accentColor` (`#7c5cff`) seeds the theme, so a test can assert the served CSS picks it up. |
| `.obsidian/app.json` | `newLinkFormat: shortest` and `attachmentFolderPath: attachments` are the settings the link resolver should respect. |
| `.obsidian/core-plugins.json` | Realism: a real vault has one, and the app must not choke on unknown files under `.obsidian/`. |
| `index.md` | Root landing page. Also the one file that touches every feature at once, so it is the natural smoke-test target. |
| `meetings/Meeting Notes.md` | **Ambiguous basename, half one.** Two segments deep. |
| `projects/kbview/notes/Meeting Notes.md` | **Ambiguous basename, half two.** Four segments deep. A bare `[[Meeting Notes]]` must resolve to the *meetings* copy because its path is shorter; only an explicit path link may reach this one. |
| `Reading List.md` | **Filename with spaces.** Every generated URL for it has to be percent-encoded, and a bare wikilink to it must still resolve. |
| `references/知识管理.md` | **Non-ASCII filename.** Guards against byte-slicing a UTF-8 path, against a folder sort that panics on CJK, and against a link resolver that only matches ASCII. Its body also mixes CJK, Japanese and Latin in one paragraph, and uses CJK tags. |
| `references/syntax/wikilinks.md` | Every wikilink shape in one file: `[[Note]]`, `[[Note\|alias]]`, `[[Note#Heading]]`, `[[#Local Heading]]`, a path-qualified link, and two deliberately **unresolved** links (`[[Does Not Exist]]`, `[[Also Missing\|…]]`). Unresolved must render inert, not 404 the page. |
| `references/syntax/callouts.md` | `> [!note]` untitled, `> [!warning] With A Title`, `> [!tip]` containing a list and a code fence, a three-level **nested** callout, foldable `-`/`+` variants, and a plain blockquote that must *not* become a callout. |
| `references/syntax/gfm-features.md` | Tables with alignment markers, nested task lists, strikethrough, footnotes, autolinks. Also the **tag traps**: real tags (`#kbview/markdown`), a `#tag` inside a fenced block, one in inline code, hex colours (`#ffffff`) in a heading, and `#42` issue numbers. None of the traps may reach the tag index. |
| `references/syntax/math-and-diagrams.md` | Inline `$x^2$`, a display `$$…$$` block, a multi-line `aligned` block, two mermaid fences, an SVG embed — plus `$5`/`$7` prices and `$HOME` in code, which must **not** be parsed as math. |
| `projects/kbview/overview.md` | Hosts the note **transclusion** `![[Glossary]]`. |
| `projects/kbview/design/rendering-pipeline.md` | Fenced code in `mermaid`, `rust`, `python`, `json`, `text` — the highlighter needs more than one language. |
| `projects/kbview/design/decisions/adr-001-markdown-engine.md` | **Deepest note (5 segments)**, for breadcrumb and folder-tree rendering. Also holds the three-level nested callout. |
| `Glossary.md` | Transclusion target. Kept short so a diff of the transcluded output is readable. |
| `attachments/image.png` | Target of `![[image.png]]`. 64×40 truecolour PNG. |
| `attachments/document.pdf` | Target of `![[document.pdf]]` — a PDF **embed**, not a link. |
| `attachments/diagram.svg` | Target of `![[diagram.svg]]`. |

All 14 notes carry YAML frontmatter with `title`, a `tags` array, `date` and
`aliases`, so frontmatter parsing has no lucky path.

## `plain-markdown/` — not a vault

Proves the app is not secretly Obsidian-only. There is **no `.obsidian/`
directory anywhere**, and `verify_fixtures.py` asserts the string `[[` does not
appear in any file here — not even inside a code span. If wikilink rendering
shows up in this root, vault rules are leaking.

| Path | Why it exists |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md` | There is deliberately **no `index.md` at this root**, so the landing-page fallback chain (`index.md` → `README.md` → generated listing) is forced onto its second rung. It also tabulates every relative-link style the resolver must handle. |
| `guides/index.md` | A subfolder that **has** an index file: opening the folder must show this page. |
| `reference/` | A subfolder with **no** index file and no README: opening it must produce a **generated folder listing** of its three notes. |
| `guides/advanced/reverse-proxy.md` | Two levels deep, so its links climb `../` and `../../` and its image reference is `../../assets/diagram.png`. This is where "resolve relative to the file, not to the root" bugs show up. |
| `assets/diagram.png`, `assets/screenshot.png` | Referenced from three different depths, with and without a leading `./`. |
| `README.md → ./does-not-exist.md`<br>`reference/http-api.md → ./nope.md` | The only two **intentionally broken** relative links. The app must render a dead link, not a 500. The verifier asserts these two and *only* these two are broken, so an accidental typo elsewhere fails the check. |

## `mixed-media/` — a bare document folder

No `.obsidian/`, and only one Markdown file. Proves the app is a document
browser, not just a Markdown renderer.

| Path | Why it exists |
| --- | --- |
| `report.pdf` | **Valid PDF**, hand-assembled: header, catalog, page tree, Helvetica font resource, content stream, and a cross-reference table whose offsets are computed. Verified to open (`%PDF-` header, `%%EOF` trailer, `startxref` landing on `xref`) and confirmed to render via Quick Look. |
| `meeting-minutes.docx` | **Valid DOCX**, built with `zipfile`. Contains the four required parts plus `styles.xml`, `numbering.xml` and `docProps/`. Deliberately a *real* conversion test: title, two heading levels, a paragraph mixing bold/italic/strikethrough/underline runs, a bulleted list with a nested level, a numbered list, a three-row bordered table with a header row, a block quote, and an external hyperlink resolved through `document.xml.rels`. |
| `logo.png` | 32×32 truecolour PNG, chunk CRCs verified. |
| `photo.jpg` | 16×16 **baseline JPEG**, 4:4:4, written with hand-built Huffman tables and an identity quantisation table. It really decodes — `sips` reads it as 16×16 and recovers the source colour to within one unit per channel. |
| `chart.svg` | SVG served as an image; parses as XML and declares the SVG namespace. |
| `inventory.csv` | **12 records, 5 columns.** Row 10 has a quoted field containing a comma; row 11 has a quoted field containing a **newline**, so the file has more physical lines than records. A CSV viewer that splits on `\n` reports 13 rows and fails. |
| `notes.txt` | Must render as preformatted text, **not** through the Markdown parser — its `===` underline would otherwise become an `<h1>`. Also carries tabs, `<angle brackets>`, `&`, a very long line, and non-ASCII. |
| `config.json` | Text/JSON viewer, with non-ASCII values, an empty object, an empty array, a `null` and a float. |
| `opaque.bin` | **Unknown extension**, binary, contains NUL bytes. Must fall back to download-only rather than being decoded as text. |
| `LICENSE` | **No extension at all.** The type sniffer must not index past the end of an empty suffix. Also download-only. |
| `index.md` | The folder's landing page, and a by-hand click-through checklist. |
